description: Read findings for a Check run by checkId. Returns locators and disposition summaries on claims, assumptions, warrants, evidence, and rebuttals, and on slides, annexes, presentations and sets when those levels were quoted (target.kind is structure, with targetKind and targetRef) — not document excerpts.

checkId.description: Durable Check run identity returned by verify_deliverable.

productIds.description: Return only these verifier products, for example ["RS01"].

subjectRef.description: Return only findings on this claim or assumption node id.

unitIds.description: Return only these plan unit ids.

name: get_findings
title: Read Check findings
